FN-5HKB33-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 1
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Artis 'A.J.'
McCampbell
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 07/17/2023
House Bill 1 as introduced would appropriate $10 million from the State General Fund for the
fiscal year ending September 30, 2023, to the Department of Mental Health to be used for an
adolescent mental health unit in Pickens County.
